Observation: Low thresholds keep weak gradients -> more edges, but some texture/noise is picked up as false edges.
Mid-range thresholds balance edge count against false positives.
High thresholds keep only strong gradients -> fewer, cleaner edges, but some true lesion-boundary edges may be dropped (broken edges).
Mid-range thresholds balance edge count against false positives. Larger Gaussian kernel smooths more before the gradient step -> thinner, less fragmented edges but slightly less fine detail.
